purpose: Produce one localized repair action for one identified open/invalid defect without changing confirmed dimensions.
trigger: Use when one defect and one approved repair mode are known; not a generic repair search.

inputs.name: located_defect
inputs.description: One open edge, invalid face, nonmanifold junction, or localized defect identity.

inputs.name: selected_repair_method
inputs.description: One preselected target-version repair mode and known call/signature if available.

inputs.name: allowable_scope
inputs.description: Faces/edges/body region and dimensions that may not change.

preconditions: Exactly one defect is located and edit region is bounded.
One known target-version mode is selected; automatic mode search is forbidden.

outputs.name: single_defect_repair
outputs.description: One mode, target selector, exact call fragment, or needs_manual_review.

outputs.name: resulting_condition
outputs.description: One closure/validity condition to check afterward.

outputs.name: preservation_checks
outputs.description: Dimensions/topology constraints that must remain unchanged.

postconditions: One repair action is emitted for one defect with one post-repair condition.
The emitted repair constrains outside-scope dimensions; actual preservation remains untested until execution and measurement.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21-compatible contract reasoning; no host execution is performed by this operation.
implementation.notes: The reusable artifact is this candidate guidance contract; no executable implementation is claimed. Unknown mode/API remains needs_manual_review; no generic repairer is claimed.

ambiguity_checks: Use only the declared identity, state, or geometry predicates; do not substitute recorded FaceN/BodyN aliases or an arbitrary collection member.
If the declared evidence cannot make the target unique, return needs_manual_review and do not continue.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: Re-enumerate affected topology after repair before downstream selection.

failure_modes.condition: Local repair mode or target-version call is unverified.
failure_modes.detection: Mode/signature missing or conflicts with target API.

failure_modes.condition: Edit touches beyond allowable local defect.

recovery.action: Return needs_manual_review and obtain version-specific method.
Reduce to one defect or stop for review.

validation.method: Validate this object against operation-template.schema.json and compare operation_id with the EX/ER catalog slug.
validation.expected: The object is schema-valid, remains candidate, and declares exactly one bounded execution_recovery action.

validation.method: Read the linked single-operation guidance and compare its input, result, procedure, and rejection fields with this contract.
validation.expected: The contract exposes every declared input/output and preserves refusal, recovery, and needs_manual_review behavior.

validation.method: Use the operation-specific controller or host-tool adapter only after the required authorization and target-state gates are independently satisfied.
validation.expected: One repair action is emitted for one defect with one post-repair condition.

evidence_level.notes: Guidance interface checked on host; synthetic independent application reviewed. No controller event or repaired geometry was observed for this guide.
